Lower intellectual property and manufacturing revenue more than offset growth in energy operations; the wider loss reflected lower total costs but a swing to other expense, including unrealized equity losses and derivative losses.

: Revenue fell to $263K from $7.8M as no paid-up license agreements were executed in the quarter.
: Revenue rose 37% to $19.5M, supported by higher oil production and prices and higher natural gas liquids prices.
: Revenue declined 12% to $27.2M, as lower air-distribution and office-products sales outweighed stable transportation-safety revenue.
: Printronix revenue increased 13% to $7.5M, led by 25% growth in printers and parts and 11% growth in consumable products.
